SELECT s.STORE_NO AS storeNo, s.STORE_NAME AS storeName, s.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, c.KOR AS sCategoryName, s.S_ADDR AS sAddr, sd.SUB_TITLE AS subTitle, pm.MENU_NAME AS popularMenuName, sf.FILE_PATH AS filePath, sf.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM STORE s JOIN RESERVATION r ON s.STORE_NO = r.STORE_NO AND r.CDATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL sd ON s.STORE_NO = sd.STORE_NO
LEFT JOIN CODE c ON s.S_CATEGORY = c.VALUE AND c.TYPE = 'S_CATEGORY'
LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE sf ON s.STORE_NO = sf.STORE_NO AND sf.IS_MAIN = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STORE_NO, MENU_NAME FROM ( SELECT m.STORE_NO, m.MENU_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STORE_NO ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, m.MENU_NO ASC ) AS rn FROM RESERVATION r JOIN STORE_MENU m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO WHERE r.CDATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY m.STORE_NO, m.MENU_NO, m.MENU_NAME ) x WHERE rn = 1 ) pm ON s.STORE_NO = pm.STORE_NO
GROUP BY s.STORE_NO, s.STORE_NAME, s.S_CATEGORY, c.KOR, s.S_ADDR, sd.SUB_TITLE, pm.MENU_NAME, sf.FILE_PATH, sf.FILE_NAME
ORDER BY COUNT(r.RSV_NO) DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, p.I_SUB_NO AS iSubNo, pf.FILE_PATH AS filePath, pf.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM PRODUCT p JOIN ORDER_DETAIL od ON p.PRODUCT_NO = od.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE pf ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pf.PRODUCT_NO AND pf.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, p.I_SUB_NO, pf.FILE_PATH, pf.FILE_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(od.PRODUCT_NO) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO ASC
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, SOCIALTYPE AS socialType FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SOCIALTYPE IN ('KAKAO', 'NAVER') AND (PHONE IS NULL OR PHONE = '')

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, S.S_CATEGORY AS sCategory, SF.FILE_PATH AS filePath, SF.FILE_NAME AS fileName,
CASE WHEN S.S_STATUS = 'GEN' THEN '유니펫 회원사' WHEN S.S_STATUS = 'AFF' THEN '유니펫 제휴사' ELSE '' END AS badgeText,
M.MENU_NAME AS menuName1, M.MENU_PRICE AS menuPrice1
FROM STORE S
LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE SF ON S.STORE_NO = SF.STORE_NO AND SF.IS_MAIN = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT X.STORE_NO, X.MENU_NAME, X.MENU_PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY X.STORE_NO ORDER BY X.MENU_PRICE ASC, X.MENU_NO ASC ) AS RN FROM STORE_MENU X WHERE X.M_STATUS = 'Y' ) M ON S.STORE_NO = M.STORE_NO AND M.RN = 1
WHERE S.S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory} AND S.S_STATUS IN ('AFF', 'GEN', 'EXT') AND ( S.STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S.S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.MENU_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.S_STATUS = 'AFF' THEN 1 WHEN S.S_STATUS = 'GEN' THEN 2 WHEN S.S_STATUS = 'EXT' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, S.STORE_NAME ASC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STORE WHERE S_STATUS != 'EXT' AND S_CATEGORY = #{sCategory} AND ( STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, P.BRAND AS brand, PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType, PAS.A_SUB_TYPE AS aSubType, PIS.I_SUB_TYPE AS iSubType, PF.FILE_PATH AS filePath, PF.FILE_NAME AS fileName, IFNULL(RV.RATING, 0) AS rating, IFNULL(RV.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS reviewCount FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON PF.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PF.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB PIS ON PIS.I_SUB_NO = P.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB PAS ON PAS.A_SUB_NO = P.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN PAM ON PAM.A_MAIN_NO = PAS.A_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.PRODUCT_NO, ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1) AS RATING, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW R GROUP BY R.PRODUCT_NO ) RV ON RV.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y' AND ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.BRAND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAS.A_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PIS.I_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB PIS ON PIS.I_SUB_NO = P.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB PAS ON PAS.A_SUB_NO = P.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN PAM ON PAM.A_MAIN_NO = PAS.A_MAIN_NO WHERE ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.BRAND LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAM.A_MAIN_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PAS.A_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR PIS.I_SUB_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.TITLE AS title, B.B_CONTENT AS bContent, BTS.B_MAIN_NO AS bMainNo FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO WHERE BTS.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo} AND B.B_STATUS = 'Y' AND B.PRIVATE = 'N' AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE_SUB BTS ON B.B_SUB_NO = BTS.B_SUB_NO WHERE BTS.B_MAIN_NO = #{bMainNo} AND ( B.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR B.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_ADDR AS sAddr, SD.SUB_TITLE AS subTitle, SF.FILE_PATH AS filePath, SF.FILE_NAME AS fileName FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL SD ON S.STORE_NO = SD.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_FILE SF ON S.STORE_NO = SF.STORE_NO AND SF.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN','AFF') AND S.STORE_NAME LIKE '%유치원%' ORDER BY S.STORE_NO DESC
